activity-date.narrative: LKA 1 was founded in 1953 and is a IPPF member. LKA 1 Vision is ‘A country with access to Sexual and Reproductive Health as a right to all’. The project aims for: Improved changes on individual level, Improved legislation and policies on SRHR Transformed social norms and increased knowledge on SRHR Strenghtening of civil society, empowerment and mobilisation LKA 1 was founded in 1953. LKA 1 Vision is ‘A country with access to Sexual and Reproductive Health as a right to all’.The project from October 2025 to 2028 focuses on; Legal reform of the abortion law, implementation of CSE for youth having hearing impariments and improved response to SGBV with increased access to leagal and psycosocial support
